description: The quickest way to a cartoon: send the script as people write one, a line each, Name: what they say, and get the jabbertoon.com link that opens it in the editor ready to play and to record as a video (free, no account). Read too: (happy, waves) in a line; [Leo walks to Mia] on a line of its own; Place: Beach (another later starts the next scene); Cast: Mia (cat). Our characters come by name (Sunny, Grump, Ria, Bob, Kiki) and a new name becomes one of our 3D cast. What was not used is in notes. Example: {"script": "Place: Beach\nMia (cat): (worried) Have you seen my hat?\nLeo: (looks around) Is it on that crab?"}.

place.description: Where it is, by name: Beach, City, Space, Old Keep... (else its Place: line, else the Meadow).

script.description: The script: a line each, Name: what they say.

title.description: Its name (else the script's Title: line).
